target.title: fix(discord): deliver text fallback when media send fails
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When Discord rejects media (oversized attachment, aborted upload, or any delivery error), the entire reply — text AND media — is silently lost. Dispatch reports outcome=completed.

Closes #99021

## Root Cause / Fix

`sendMessageDiscord` had no recovery path for media errors. On any media send failure, fall back to `sendDiscordText` with the original message text, preserving `replyTo` and formatting.

## Evidence

### Real Discord proof — text fallback works

```
$ pnpm openclaw message send --channel discord \
  --target "channel:1522419241314156677" \
  --message "413 fix proof — text survives after error" \
  --media /tmp/huge.zip  # 26 MB

→ ✅ Sent via Discord. Message ID: 1522490696362098799
```

Confirm: message text delivered to Discord channel despite media rejection.

### Test (unit)

```
sendMessageDiscord > falls back to text-only send when Discord rejects oversized media (#99021)
  → mock 413 → text fallback delivered ✅
```

## Change Type
- [x] Bug fix
## Scope
- [x] Discord channel (send layer)
## Security Impact
- New permissions? No · Secrets changed? No · New network calls? No
